answer: Grade every grader on a curve. Each account's scores get shifted by the gap between its own average over its last 30 seals and the network's average over the same stretch. If the network averages 1.6 and an account averages 2.4, every score it gives counts 0.8 lower. Say a farm account hands a 3 to a sibling's thin note on tundra shipping or a meadow seed swap. That 3 barely moves anything unless it also dumps 0s and 1s elsewhere, and those land against real verdicts and cost it seats. Under 5 seals, scores sit halfway to the average, since there's no horizon yet.
